searchText: Heads up, we probably want to support this moving forward or else it could become a nighmare for the code to rebase on top of capella: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/314/files Once it's merged, I'll open an engine API PR to align that with v3 endpoint Also, do we want https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3095 ? I'd love to include this and blockValue for devnet3 so it'll make the rebasing life easier down the line. Perhaps we can name the current devnet3 as pre-devnet3 and do another devnet3 with the latest engine api and withdrawal spec yes pls for above two PRs, they are already part of lodestar code base, for 314, we also have some handling for old format, but it would be difficult to revert 3095 and have withdrawals so for devnet 4, i vote for withdrawals enabled with both PRs included Hi! excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
Heads up, we probably want to support this moving forward or else it could become a nighmare for the code to rebase on top of capella: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/314/files

Once it's merged, I'll open an engine API PR to align that with v3 endpoint

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: Also, do we want https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3095 ? I'd love to include this and blockValue for devnet3 so it'll make the rebasing life easier down the line. Perhaps we can name the current devnet3 as pre-devnet3 and do another devnet3 with the latest engine api and withdrawal spec

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: yes pls for above two PRs, they are already part of lodestar code base, for 314, we also have some handling for old format, but it would be difficult to revert 3095 and have withdrawals

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: so for devnet 4, i vote for withdrawals enabled with both PRs included
